name: Flooring
tagline: Timber, vinyl and carpet — the surfaces underfoot
description: Everything here competes with tile on warmth and comfort. The decision usually comes down to three questions: how much water will it see, how much traffic, and does the client want the real thing or a convincing print of it.

materials.name: Laminate flooring
materials.blurb: Printed timber look on an HDF core — quick, clean, affordable
materials.description: A photographic decor over a dense fibreboard core with a click-lock joint. Installs over an existing floor in a day per room with no adhesive, but standing water will destroy the core.

materials.name: SPC flooring
materials.blurb: Stone-polymer core — genuinely waterproof click flooring
materials.description: A rigid mineral-and-PVC core that does not swell, so it can go in kitchens, balconies and even bathrooms. Dimensionally stable in heat, which matters in Indian summers where WPC can move.

materials.name: LVT (luxury vinyl tile)
materials.blurb: Flexible vinyl planks with a very convincing print
materials.description: Thin, quiet and warm underfoot, glued or loose-laid over a level screed. The best print quality in the vinyl family and the standard in retail and hospitality fit-outs.

materials.name: Vinyl sheet flooring
materials.blurb: Continuous roll with welded seams — hygienic and seamless
materials.description: Laid in a roll and heat-welded at the joints, so there is nowhere for dirt or water to enter. The specification for hospitals, labs and clinics, and a sensible one for a busy kids' room.

materials.name: Engineered wood flooring
materials.blurb: Real timber wear layer on a plywood core — stable in humidity
materials.description: A 3–6 mm layer of genuine hardwood over a cross-laminated core, so it moves far less than solid wood in Indian humidity. Can be sanded once or twice depending on the wear layer.

materials.name: Solid wood flooring
materials.blurb: Full-thickness hardwood planks, sandable for decades
materials.description: Solid teak, oak or merbau boards that can be sanded and refinished many times over a lifetime. Expensive, sensitive to moisture, and unmatched underfoot.

materials.name: Carpet tile
materials.blurb: Modular 500×500 squares — replace one, not the room
materials.description: Office flooring that accepts a coffee spill philosophically: lift the damaged tile, drop in a spare. Also allows patterning and zoning without a custom carpet order.

materials.name: Broadloom carpet
materials.blurb: Wall-to-wall roll carpet — the quietest floor there is
materials.description: Nothing absorbs sound and softens a room like full carpet, which is why hotels and home theatres still use it. Plan the cleaning regime before specifying it in an Indian city.

materials.name: Cork flooring
materials.blurb: Warm, quiet, renewable — and it forgives dropped glasses
materials.description: Harvested bark that regrows, giving a floor that is soft underfoot, naturally insulating and antimicrobial. Niche in India but excellent in nurseries, studios and reading rooms.

materials.name: Wooden deck flooring
materials.blurb: Outdoor timber or composite decking for balconies and terraces
materials.description: Ipe, teak or WPC boards laid on joists or pedestals to turn a balcony into a usable room. Natural timber needs annual oiling; composite does not, at the cost of looking slightly less real.
